schemaVersion: 1
schemaFingerprint: ""
playerSlots:
  - playerId: 0
    # Pairs one keyboard, one mouse and one gamepad at once so any of them can drive player 0
    # without re-joining. The per-layout bound leaves spare devices for other local players.
    pairAllMatchingDevices: true
    maxDevicesPerLayout: 1
    # Suppress prompt/icon jitter when the player alternates rapidly between devices.
    deviceSwitchDebounceMs: 120
    joinAction:
      type: Button
      action: JoinGame
      expectedControlType: Button
      deviceBindings:
        - "<Keyboard>/enter"
        - "<Gamepad>/start"
      updateMode: EventDriven
      longPressMs: 0
      longPressValueThreshold: 0.5
    contexts:
      - name: Gameplay
        actionMap: PlayerActions
        priority: 0
        blocksLowerPriority: true
        bindings:
          - type: Vector2
            action: Move
            expectedControlType: Vector2
            deviceBindings:
              - "<Gamepad>/leftStick"
              - "<Mouse>/delta"
            compositeBindings:
              - name: 2DVector
                parameters: mode=2
                parts:
                  - name: up
                    path: "<Keyboard>/w"
                  - name: down
                    path: "<Keyboard>/s"
                  - name: left
                    path: "<Keyboard>/a"
                  - name: right
                    path: "<Keyboard>/d"
            updateMode: Polling
            longPressMs: 0
            longPressValueThreshold: 0.5
          - type: Button
            action: Confirm
            expectedControlType: Button
            deviceBindings:
              - "<Gamepad>/buttonSouth"
              - "<Keyboard>/space"
              - "<Mouse>/leftButton"
            updateMode: EventDriven
            longPressMs: 500
            longPressValueThreshold: 0.5
